scenes.title: Game of Thrones
scenes.summary: Arlette talks about Game of Thrones. Mathias tells her he's seeing Louis Garrel.

scenes.title: Adjani Arrives
scenes.summary: Isabelle Adjani arrives and Andréa tells her about Sacha Hartman's new film.

scenes.title: Calling Hartman
scenes.summary: Andréa calls Sacha Hartman. He refuses to work with Isabelle because she rejected his script four years ago.

scenes.title: Arguing Over Adjani
scenes.summary: Andréa and Noémie argue over how to handle Isabelle Adjani's situation.

scenes.title: Interviews in My Office
scenes.summary: Hicham orders Gabriel and Andréa to conduct interviews for the junior agent position in his office.

scenes.title: Andréa's Confession
scenes.summary: Andréa confesses to Gabriel that she had a one-night stand with Hicham.

scenes.title: Voice Tests
scenes.summary: Sofia tells Gabriel that Julien Doré wants her to do voice tests.

scenes.title: The True Story
scenes.summary: Andréa confesses to Camille that she threw out Hartman's script four years ago and asks her to sabotage their meeting.

scenes.title: Recording Booth
scenes.summary: Sofia records for Julien Doré. Julien asks Gabriel to wait outside the booth.

scenes.title: Meeting Hartman
scenes.summary: Andréa meets Sacha Hartman. He explains his deep childhood admiration for Isabelle and his heartbreak over her rejection.

scenes.title: Sabotaging Eugénie
scenes.summary: Noémie gives terrible advice to an applicant to sabotage her interview with Hicham.

scenes.title: Eugénie's Interview
scenes.summary: Eugénie acts strangely during her interview with Hicham and Gabriel, following Noémie's advice.

scenes.title: Mathias and Isabelle
scenes.summary: Mathias and Isabelle Adjani discuss Sacha Hartman's screenplay.

scenes.title: Radio Interview
scenes.summary: Sacha Hartman finishes a radio interview and leaves with Camille.

scenes.title: Anti-Hartman Protest
scenes.summary: Camille pretends to lose her keys as protesters appear, putting Sacha in a cab to sabotage the meeting.

scenes.title: Waiting for Julien
scenes.summary: Gabriel and Sofia wait for Julien Doré to call back.

scenes.title: Benoît's Interview
scenes.summary: During Benoît's interview, Noémie scares him with stories about Gérard Depardieu.

scenes.title: Rescheduling the Meeting
scenes.summary: Sacha complains to Andréa that Adjani was unavailable. Andréa reschedules the meeting.

scenes.title: The Lead Role
scenes.summary: Gabriel gets a text from Julien Doré offering Sofia the lead role in his movie.

scenes.title: Hicham Flirts
scenes.summary: Hicham flirts with Andréa in her office, but she rejects his advances.

scenes.title: Léopoldine's Interview
scenes.summary: Hicham and Gabriel interview Léopoldine Schneck. Hicham makes Gabriel uncomfortable.

scenes.title: Hallway Confrontation
scenes.summary: Gabriel confronts Hicham about his unprofessional behavior during the interviews.

scenes.title: Arlette's Advice
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to Arlette about his jealousy over Sofia and Julien. Arlette advises him to trust her.

scenes.title: Noémie's Visit
scenes.summary: Noémie visits Mathias at his apartment, giving him a massage to help with his stress.

scenes.title: Camille's Interview
scenes.summary: Camille finally has her interview for the junior agent position with Hicham and Gabriel.

scenes.title: No Outside Interference
scenes.summary: Sofia tells Julien that Gabriel is her boyfriend. Julien insists on no outside interference.

scenes.title: The Improvisation
scenes.summary: Sacha meets Isabelle and makes her do a humiliating improvisation. Camille lies to save Andréa.

scenes.title: Le départ d'Adjani
scenes.summary: Isabelle leaves angrily. Camille tells Mathias that the meeting was a disaster.

scenes.title: Le secret de Mathias
scenes.summary: When the agents confront Camille, Mathias steps in and finally admits that Camille is his daughter.
